sources.title: NVIDIA NemotronLabs VoiceChat 11B - GitHub
sources.snippet: NVIDIA NemotronLabs VoiceChat is an 11B end-to-end, real-time full-duplex speech model jointly performing streaming speech understanding and generation [1, 2]. Unlike cascaded ASR→LLM→TTS pipelines, it unifies these in one architecture, enabling seamless full-duplex voice interaction while cutting multi-model handoffs and end-to-end latency.
